+import io

+import OpenSSL.crypto
+import pycurl
+
+from pynubank.exception import NuRequestException
+from pynubank.utils.http_response import Response
+
+
+def _configure_ssl_context(pkcs12_data: bytes, pkcs12_password: str):
+    def _handler(*args):
+        ssl_ctx = args[-1]
+        password = b'' if pkcs12_password is None else pkcs12_password.encode()
+        pkcs12 = OpenSSL.crypto.load_pkcs12(pkcs12_data, password)
+        ssl_ctx.use_certificate(pkcs12.get_certificate())
+        ssl_ctx.use_privatekey(pkcs12.get_privatekey())
+
+    return _handler
+
+
+def _request(method: str, url: str, json_data: dict = None, headers: dict = None,
+             pkcs12_data: bytes = None, pkcs12_password: str = '') -> Response:
+    body = b'' if json_data is None else json.dumps(json_data).encode()
+    response_body = io.BytesIO()
+    response_headers = {}
+
+    def _handle_header(header_line: bytes):
+        line = header_line.decode('iso-8859-1').strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith('HTTP/'):
+            return len(header_line)
+
+        if ':' in line:
+            key, value = line.split(':', 1)
+            response_headers[key.strip()] = value.strip()
+
+        return len(header_line)
+
+    curl = pycurl.Curl()
+    try:
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, [f'{key}: {value}' for key, value in (headers or {}).items()])
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEDATA, response_body)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.HEADERFUNCTION, _handle_header)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.NOSIGNAL, 1)
+
+        if pkcs12_data:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.SSL_CTX_FUNCTION, _configure_ssl_context(pkcs12_data, pkcs12_password))
+
+        if method == 'GET':
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPGET, 1)
+        else:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 1)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, body)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDSIZE, len(body))
+
+        curl.perform()
+        status_code = curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE)
+        effective_url = curl.getinfo(pycurl.EFFECTIVE_URL)
+    finally:
+        curl.close()
+
+    return Response(url=effective_url, status_code=status_code, headers=response_headers,
+                    content=response_body.getvalue())
+
+
+def get(url: str, headers: dict = None, pkcs12_data: bytes = None, pkcs12_password: str = '') -> Response:
+    return _request('GET', url, headers=headers, pkcs12_data=pkcs12_data, pkcs12_password=pkcs12_password)
+
+
+def post(url: str, json: dict = None, headers: dict = None, pkcs12_data: bytes = None,
+         pkcs12_password: str = '') -> Response:
+    return _request('POST', url, json_data=json, headers=headers, pkcs12_data=pkcs12_data,
+                    pkcs12_password=pkcs12_password)

+import json
+
+
+class Response:
+    def __init__(self, url: str = '', status_code: int = 200, headers=None, content: bytes = b''):
+        self.url = url
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.headers = {} if headers is None else headers
+        self.content = content
+
+    @property
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        return self.content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
+
+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self.text or '{}')
